observations: Photo 0 shows a vertical, cylindrical stainless steel tank with a polished mirror finish.
The tank has a bolted top flange/hatch and a side-mounted circular access port near the base.
A second large object, wrapped in dark material and clear plastic film, stands to the right of the stainless tank.
The floor and walls are tiled, suggesting an indoor or industrial installation.
A digital watermark 'TEE TECH' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is overlaid on both images.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate showing capacity, pressure rating, and material grade.
Photo of the tank with a measuring tape to confirm height and diameter.
Photo of the interior of the tank through the access port.
Clarification on whether the wrapped item and any external valves/piping are included.
response.reason: The tank's capacity and material specifications are the primary determinants of its value and are not visible or stated. Without scale or a nameplate, a reliable valuation is not possible.
